title: TeamAndOrgViewSetMixin: team scoping and default permission stack
answers: How is team scoping enforced in PostHog API viewsets?
What permission classes are applied by default to viewsets?
Can I override get_queryset in a viewset?
body:
- Every team/org-nested viewset inherits `TeamAndOrgViewSetMixin` (posthog/api/routing.py); don't roll your own scoping.
- Never override `get_queryset`: the mixin runs `safely_get_queryset` -> `_filter_queryset_by_parents_lookups` -> `_filter_queryset_by_access_level`. Override `safely_get_queryset`; `dangerously_get_queryset` bypasses scoping and needs justification.
- `dangerously_get_permissions` builds a fixed list: IsAuthenticated, APIScopePermission, AccessControlPermission, then TeamMemberAccessPermission (team/project view) or OrganizationMemberPermissions (org view), then further checks. Extras are added via the `permission_classes` class attribute; the default list is not replaceable that way. Overriding the whole method is the only way to drop them.
- `InternalAPIAuthentication` gets only IsAuthenticated; sharing-token authenticators get only SharingTokenPermission.
- Set `scope_object` on every viewset; APIScopePermission raises ImproperlyConfigured otherwise. Override with `required_scopes` on an action.
- `_filter_queryset_by_access_level` filters only for action == "list"; detail access relies on AccessControlPermission at object level, so keep it.
- Serializers get the team via `self.context["get_team"]()` (lazy lambdas from `get_serializer_context`), not `request.user.team`.
